# The Hunting Grounds
Yautja are free to hunt anywhere on the hunting grounds, except for the areas listed below.
- Yautja are not to directly alter the environment in a way that directly benefits one side, such as blowing up Lambda, Eta or hydro, or clearing a straight path to either side's base. - Yautja standing around uncloaked near prey without interacting with it should remove themselves from sight. Standing uncloaked in full view of either side while not interacting is low roleplay. Running around uncloaked does not count. - Going AFK on the hunting grounds is forbidden. - Freely interacting with and showing yourself to colonists outside of a hunt is forbidden. - Using fuel tanks and other objects, like lizards, as makeshift traps is prohibited. Using them mid-fight if the opportunity presents itself is fine, but they should not be placed beforehand for that purpose.
## FOB and Hideout Yautja should not disrupt or harm GOVFOR or OPFOR fortifications. This includes the INSFOR Hideout.
- Yautja may go near or even through non-FOB and non-Hideout fortifications, as long as they make sure, to the best of their ability, that they are not noticed and that they do not damage or disrupt any part of them, such as sentries, barricades and supplies. - Yautja may taunt marines in non-FOB and non-Hideout fortifications and beckon them outside, but should disengage if they do not come out. - Passing through FOB fortifications is forbidden, and going near them should be avoided unless it is to return a dead human. Taunting humans in FOB fortifications is forbidden. - Yautja may chase fleeing prey to fortifications, but not into them.
## Ship Yautja may go to the GOVFOR or OPFOR ship only for gear recovery, returning thralls, and abominations. While on the ship, be as quick and efficient as you can and try to avoid collateral damage. See [textlink="Gear Recovery" link="AU14YautjaHonorCodeGearRecovery"], [textlink="Thralls" link="AU14YautjaHonorCodeThralls"] and [textlink="Prey Caveats" link="AU14YautjaHonorCodePreyCaveats"].
The same rules apply should Yautja gear end up inside a We-Yu facility.
## Comms - While in GOVFOR, OPFOR or INSFOR possession, comms fall under the FOB fortification clause. - While in threat possession, Yautja may not start fights there, but may chase prey who run there to finish an engagement, including inside. - The area becomes valid to hunt in once GOVFOR have evacuated.
## Hive The hive is the area where xeno or neomorph captures are held, or where the hive core is. Hunting in or entering the hive is forbidden under all circumstances, unless there is an infected Yautja inside. See [textlink="Prey Caveats" link="AU14YautjaHonorCodePreyCaveats"].
## Frontline Yautja may not initiate engagements on the frontline, but may chase prey fleeing there to finish the job. While doing so, Yautja may use [bold]only[/bold] their melee weapons. Should a Yautja self-destruct there, it must be set to small.
## Sieges During FOB or hive sieges, Yautja may hunt only the besieging faction, and only away from the barricades or the hive. You may hunt troops moving to the siege, or around the backline. As with the frontline clause, chasing prey retreating to the siege is allowed.
